reasoning:
I'm tracing the type error back to around lines 140-146, where the options type for b.part doesn't seem to include a 'color' property that the put helper expects.

I think the actual issue is that those four helper signatures—put, box, sphere, lathe—all try to type their color parameter as Opt["color"], but color is really a positional argument to b.part, not a field on the options object, so that index access is invalid. The fix should involve introducing a proper Fill type derived from the actual function parameters instead of pulling it off Opt.

Confirming ColorInput is exported from the SDK root alongside the other helper imports, so I can add it to that import line safely without affecting other usages like Partial<Opt> fields.
